description: This file implements the PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy class, which is a strategy for placement filtering based on ordered metadata keys and minimum candidate requirements, used within Orleans runtime for silo placement decisions.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for filtering silo placement based on specific ordered metadata and candidate constraints.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with properties from the grain properties, parsing ordered metadata keys and minimum candidates.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Provides additional grain properties for placement by yielding key-value pairs representing metadata.
